expected_claims.text: Approximate nearest neighbor vector indexes retrieve semantically similar embeddings and trade exactness for faster search over high-dimensional vectors.

evidence.must_support: approximate search over vectors and performance/recall tradeoff

expected_claims.text: BM25 keyword search ranks documents using lexical term matching and term statistics rather than embedding distance.
For retrieval-augmented generation, vector and BM25 search have complementary failure modes, so hybrid retrieval or reranking may be appropriate when queries mix semantic and exact-token needs.

evidence.required_locator: retrieval comparison or hybrid search evaluation
evidence.must_support: complementary lexical and semantic retrieval behavior

unsupported_if: The answer claims vector search is strictly better for all RAG queries.
The answer claims BM25 understands semantic similarity without lexical evidence.
The answer omits tradeoffs such as recall, latency, exact identifiers, or reranking.
